h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kochi

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kochi

c: FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kochi for apartment associations, corporate campuses, schools and civic walkways. Our Fun Fitness machines are designed and fabricated at our Vasai factory near Mumbai, about 1110 km north of Kochi. We send them down by road and install them with our own crew or a dealer in south India.

Kochi walks in the early morning and again after work, along Marine Drive and around the city's many apartment towers. An open-air gym placed beside a walkway gets used, so that is where we suggest putting one. The other thing to plan for is the sea. Salt air and humidity stay with Kochi all year, which is why every frame we make is galvanised, and machines near the backwaters need a fresh-water rinse every few weeks.

richText.heading: Outdoor fitness for Kochi apartments and IT campuses

items.q: Will outdoor gym equipment rust in Kochi's sea air?
items.a: Our frames are galvanised steel, which resists corrosion in humid, salty air. Rinse the machines with fresh water from time to time and check the bolts during routine maintenance.

items.q: Can a corporate campus in Kochi order a small set first?
items.a: Yes. Many campuses start with three or four stations near a cafeteria or walking loop and add more later. Each machine stands on its own base, so adding stations does not disturb the first set.

items.q: Who installs the machines in Kochi?
items.a: Our installation team or a dealer in south India. They fix each machine self-standing or grouted, depending on the ground, and follow the clear space marked on your approved layout.
